skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's one of the most comfortable outfits available.

skins.name: The Zoophilist and Her Mollusca
skins.content: Achievement Star Collection/The Zoophilist and Her Mollusca. At the game expo, Vanilla dressed up as her 'Destiny Quest' character. The beast fight demo will be broadcast live, and the slugs in her pet cage are ready for their debut.
skins.quote: Thanks to the rule stating 'pets of the same species can tag out with one another', she became the arena's top contestant.
